statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun t => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; (((∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re) → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n)) → ((∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re)) → (∀ n:ℕ, I n w w=I n (low n) (low n)+2*I n (low n) (high n)+I n (high n) (high n)) → (∀ e:ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → ‖I n (low n) (low n)‖≤e*(n:ℝ)) → (∀ e:ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → ‖I n (low n) (high n)‖≤e*(n:ℝ)) → (∀ e:ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ))≤(I n (high n) (high n)).re) → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → Even n → ∃ p q:ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n

plain_statement.zh: 若主弧下界、次弧拆分、两个 o(n) 估计与高高项的单侧下界同时成立，则每个充分大的偶数都是两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: If the major-arc floor, the minor-arc split, the two o(n) bounds and the bulk one-sided floor all hold, then every sufficiently large even number is a sum of two primes.

brief.zh: 把 arc-budget-transfer、arc-major-floor、minor-bilinear-split、small-small-saving、small-bulk-saving、bulk-signed-floor 六条已发布结论机械接起来的最后一条边。它说明唯一未决的 bulk-signed-floor 不是通往定理的一步，而是已经足够推出定理本身。同文件的 bulk_floor_of_minor 进一步证明截断与不截断互相蕴含，所以 k^3≤n 的拆分没有降低难度。
brief.en: The missing edge that composes six published statements: arc-budget-transfer, arc-major-floor, minor-bilinear-split, small-small-saving, small-bulk-saving and bulk-signed-floor. It shows that the one remaining open item, bulk-signed-floor, is not a step towards the theorem but is already strong enough to be the theorem. The companion lemma bulk_floor_of_minor proves the converse as well, so truncating at k^3 <= n did not lower the difficulty.
